Clubs for Children

Cambridge Junior Chess & Go Club - this club! - We have meetings on Wednesdays at St Augustine’s Church hall in the north of Cambridge.

The Anglia Learning Chess Academy meets on Fridays during term time at Sawston Village College and is aimed at Year 6 and over (not beginners). The meetings are from 6pm-8pm. For more information contact Paul Kemp (paulkemp64 at gmail dot com)

The Cambridge Chess Academy runs fortnightly chess club and coachings sessions for children.

The online club Chess Steps runs on Fridays at 5pm and Saturdays at 6:30pm. Each session is one hour. They have many children from Cambourne and Cambridgeshire attending. Chess Steps also offer online one to one chess coaching.

Cherry Hinton Chess Club have chess sessions at Cherry Hinton Hall on Saturday afternoons. These are in three levels: Beginners 12-1pm, Improvers 1-2pm, Intermediate/Advanced: 3-4:15pm. For more information contact Daniel (chess4rookies at gmail dot com).

The Cambridge University Go Society has been running some teaching sessions for children on Sunday afternoons from 2:30pm to 4pm. These usually only run in the autumn and spring terms but there will probably be a few sessions after Easter. Contact paul361smith at gmail dot com for more information.

Many local schools have chess clubs and/or teams, including King’s, St Faiths, St Matthews, Sancton Wood, The Perse, Cambourne Village College, Soham Village College, Newnham Croft, St Pauls, St Johns, Olive Academies and Milton. There are Go clubs at St Faiths, the Perse Upper, Milton and St Mary’s. There’s a Chess & Go Club at the Stephen Perse Foundation.

Private Lessons

Chess Steps offer online one-to-one chess coaching.

Paul Smith (paul361smith at gmail dot com) offers private Go lessons to individuals or groups, either in person or online. He can also do a one-off introductory session to a group of children of the rules of any of these games: Go, Shogi, Chinese Chess, Oware.

Clubs for All Ages

The Cambridge City Chess Club meets at St Augustines Church Hall on Wednesday evenings from 7:30pm.

The Cambridge University Go Society meets on Sunday afternoons during the university autumn and spring terms only.

Here is some information about the Cambridge University Chess Club.

The Cambridge City Go Club meets at the Devonshire Arms at 7pm on Sundays.

We are entirely run by volunteers (including parents) and we really welcome help to make the club run as smoothly as possible. That includes parents helping out on the desk at the start of sessions, and helping to put tables out at the start and clearing away at the end.

If you would like any more information or have suggestions please email us (cambridgechessgo at gmail dot com).
